message: The daily leaderboard has no backend yet. This site is static hosting; POST endpoints return 404. Clients must treat any non-2xx from this path as 'leaderboard unavailable' and continue without blocking gameplay.

statusCodes.400: solve is below the leaderboard threshold
statusCodes.409: a solve for this date+user is already recorded
statusCodes.404: endpoint not deployed — client hides the leaderboard panel and stops retrying
statusCodes.501: endpoint not implemented — treated as not deployed
statusCodes.405: method not allowed on static hosting — treated as not deployed
statusCodes.410: endpoint retired — treated as not deployed
statusCodes.5xx: transient backend fault — client keeps the submission queued and retries

top.note: Reserved for a future static daily snapshot published alongside the puzzle files.
